branch_order: Call 8000B7E4 on every path; its confirmed helper subtracts 60 from a 16-bit counter when at least 60 and increments save-data word +0x264.
Nonzero halfword 0x800C7AE6 delegates to 8001FA80 and returns before later guards.
Require halfword 0x800C7D3C bit 0x1000, byte 0x800C7AE9 equal zero, and unsigned selector byte 0x800C7AA4 in 0..2; values 3 and >=4 return.
Call 8003F1D8; it returns 1 exactly when word 0x80077858 is nonzero. The runtime cursor report identifies that word as relocated VM program PC. This helper and dispatcher do not advance or clear it.
After the cursor predicate, require bytes 0x8015C562, 0x800C7AE9 (a real second read), and 0x8015C54D, plus halfword 0x800C7AD6, all zero.
On success write halfword 1 to 0x800C7AE6, clear bytes 0x800C7AA0 and 0x800C7AA1, then call 80038BC8(3); both stores precede the helper, with the second in the jal delay slot.
unproven: The meanings of raw fields are not inferred beyond separately verified evidence.
The host fixture mutates 0x800C7AE9 across the cursor helper only as an artificial reload-order probe; no retail callback mutation at that point is established.
No direct loader, allocator, free, overlay activation, or room teardown call occurs in 8001F940; effects within 8001FA80 and downstream 80038C30 remain untraced.
